# superset_row_level_security (Data Source)

Looks up a row level security rule by its name, for example to check which datasets and roles a rule that is not managed by Terraform applies to. Rule names are unique; the lookup fails when no rule has exactly that name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "superset_row_level_security" "region" {
  name = "Region of the user"
}

output "region_rule_datasets" {
  value = data.superset_row_level_security.region.tables
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the rule. The comparison is exact.

### Read-Only

- `clause` (String) SQL clause Superset appends to the queries of the datasets.
- `description` (String) Description of the rule.
- `filter_type` (String) `Regular` for a rule that applies to its roles, `Base` for a rule that applies to every role except its own.
- `group_key` (String) Group key of the rule: the clauses of rules with the same key are combined with OR.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the rule.
- `roles` (Set of Number) Identifiers of the roles of the rule.
- `tables` (Set of Number) Identifiers of the datasets the rule applies to.
